In an [[emergency]]
What to do and what to expect.
What counts as a dental emergency?
A knocked-out or broken tooth, a bad toothache, or swelling in the face or gums.
What do I do with a knocked-out tooth?
Hold it by the top, keep it moist in milk and get in touch with us right away.
Should I go to the emergency room?
For a head injury or heavy bleeding, yes. For a tooth injury on its own, get in touch with us.
Is emergency care covered?
We take most insurance plans and check your cover with you.
